legend.0: Black is winning: Black is far ahead in material, or has an unstoppable attack or forced mate

legend.3: Roughly equal: material is level and neither side has a meaningful advantage
legend.4: White is slightly better: a small edge for White such as an extra pawn, more active pieces, or a safer king
legend.5: White is clearly better: White is ahead by about a minor piece or more, or has a large lasting advantage
